title.narrative: Jharkhand Urban Water Supply Improvement Project

description.narrative: The proposed Jharkhand Urban Water Supply Improvement Project will support urban service improvement and policy initiatives of the Government of Jharkhand. The project will finance water supply infrastructure in the state capital of Ranchi, and three other towns (Hussainabad, Jhumri Telaiya, and Medininagar) located in economically and socially backward areas of Jharkhand. The Project will address capacity and institutional governance issues in the sector. This is ADB?s first urban sector Project in Jharkhand, and aligned to Jharkhand?s Vision & Action Plan, 2021 of developing sustainable cities that are spatially, economically, and socially inclusive, and India CPS of inclusive growth of low-income states.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 4092: 85% of contracts awarded and 36% disbursed as of 24 Apr 2025
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Sep 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52028/52028-004-apfs-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52028/52028-004-iee-en_10.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | May 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52028/52028-004-sddr-en.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Apr 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52028/52028-004-smr-en_3.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: PMC for all Civil Works packages have been appointed and have already been mobilized at respective sites.
PMU Consultant: Contract was awarded on 16 September 2022 and mobilized on 28 September 2022.
For Ranchi 2A water supply project:
Physical Progress: 53%
Financial Progress: 50%
For Hussainabad water supply project, the contractor has started the construction activities. The approval of the National Mission for Clean Ganga was obtained on 7 September 2022.
Physical Progress: 22%
Financial Progress: 8%
For Ranchi Intake package, contract agreement has been signed and works are under progress.
Jhumri Telaiya and Medininagar water supply works packages were retendered in September 2023. Contract agreements for both the packages have been signed and respective works are to commence soon.
The team from Strategy Consultant has been mobilized and the Inception report and rapid requirement and technical assessment (RRTA) report for 17 ULBs has been submitted and got approved by JUIDCO. The RRTA report for remaining ULBs has also been submitted.
The tender for the individual consultants to support the institutional capacity development, urban reforms, and urban policy framework will be floated by Q2 2024.
The tender for individual consultants to support institutional capacity development, urban reforms, and urban policy framework will be floated in 2024.
Plans shall be prepared for imparting trainings.
105 Community consultations have been done on Safe drinking water, safety during construction work, house service connections, increasing women participation and developing leadership skills and Gender equality to 340 Female, 530 Male and 245 Indigenous people at Ranchi 2A. At Hussainabad, 11 Community consultations on distribution system, Safety during Construction, gender equality and participation of women to 102 Female, 70 Male and 78 Indigenous peoples.
Pre-training workshop on Skill development training has been imparted to 41 community members in the first phase.
